envelopeMessage:
Happy Birthday, my love —

Today I’m celebrating you and every quiet, brilliant thing that makes you who you are. I love the way your laugh fills a room, how you notice the small details that others miss, and the steady kindness you show without asking for anything in return. Being with you has taught me how ordinary moments can become the most meaningful — a shared cup of tea, a silly inside joke, the comfort of your hand in mine.

I’m so grateful for the memories we’ve made: the late-night talks that stretched until dawn, the little adventures that turned into stories we still laugh about, and the times you held me up when I needed it most. You make me feel seen, safe, and endlessly loved. On your birthday I want you to know how proud I am of you — of your warmth, your courage, and the way you keep growing into the person you’re meant to be.

For this year ahead I wish you joy that surprises you, quiet moments that restore you, and bold chances that excite you. May you find new reasons to smile every day, and may we keep building a life full of laughter, tenderness, and shared dreams. I promise to be by your side through the small things and the big ones, to cheer for you, to listen, and to make sure you always know how deeply you are loved.
